ValidationRule.description: Only Retail Users can check Show Discounts on Quote
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.QuoteValidation__c ), NOT( CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'System Admin' ) ) , ISCHANGED( NSP_Show_Discounts__c ), NSP_Submitted_User_Role_L2__c <> 'Retail Sales', NSP_Submitted_User_Role_L2__c <> 'Admin' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only Retail Users can check Show Discounts on Quote.
